tasks.title: Ground Repository
read: root files, active OpenSpec change, current Colab and registry evidence
validation: evidence paths and assumptions ledger are complete
done_when: no implementation command or existing convention is guessed

tasks.title: Freeze Public Contracts
validation: OpenSpec strict validation when available; traceability review
done_when: public behavior is testable and design-only details remain outside specs

tasks.title: Scaffold Workspaces
validation: lockfiles parse; package/workspace discovery; no overwrite of unreviewed files
done_when: empty workspaces import/build with explicit commands

tasks.title: Add Contract Fixtures
validation: schema/golden fixture checks
done_when: core components can be implemented against deterministic evidence

tasks.title: Implement Models Config
validation: unit tests, type check, schema round trip
done_when: invalid and privacy-sensitive configurations fail clearly

tasks.title: Implement Observer Lifecycle
validation: lifecycle, rerun, double-stop, interrupted-start tests
done_when: public lifecycle behavior matches the spec

tasks.title: Implement Sampler Queue
validation: fake-clock timing, slow collector, queue overflow, shutdown timeout tests
done_when: sampler failures are bounded and observable

tasks.title: Implement Sqlite Store
validation: transaction, concurrent read, disk-full simulation, restart/readback tests
done_when: observations survive a normal stop and partial write failures are explicit

tasks.title: Wire Core Pipeline
validation: CPU-only end-to-end fake run
done_when: one run samples, persists, stops, and reopens deterministically

tasks.title: Core System Collectors
validation: fake counter, wraparound, permission, unavailable-field tests
done_when: CPU-only contract scenarios pass

tasks.title: Process Collector
validation: permission-denied, process-exit race, redaction, row-limit tests
done_when: process data is useful without default command-line leakage

tasks.title: Nvidia Collectors
validation: fake NVML, malformed fallback, timeout, multi-GPU, unavailable-field tests
done_when: GPU paths degrade cleanly without hardware

tasks.title: Framework Collectors
write_scope: framework collector files and dedicated tests
validation: not-installed, already-imported, device present/absent, import-failure tests
done_when: framework collectors never install or mutate frameworks

tasks.title: Tpu Drive Collectors
validation: detected/no-utilization, absent TPU, unmounted path, slow I/O fixtures
done_when: limitations are explicit and no synthetic utilization appears

tasks.title: Integrate Collector Registry
validation: mixed-capability matrix and failure-isolation tests
done_when: all requested capabilities resolve to an honest status

tasks.title: Implement Diagnostics Engine
validation: state-transition and flapping tests
done_when: deterministic findings are reproducible from fixtures

tasks.title: Implement Diagnostic Catalog
validation: positive, negative, alternative-explanation, and recovery fixtures
done_when: every rule exports evidence, confidence, limitation, and non-destructive guidance

tasks.title: Implement Tabular Exports
validation: schema fidelity, missing values, labels, time-range, optional-extra tests
done_when: exported records round-trip without false zeros or lost provenance

tasks.title: Implement Reports
validation: HTML escaping, offline assets, semantic headings/tables, partial data tests
done_when: reports remain readable without scripts or network

tasks.title: Implement Bundle Export
validation: deterministic file list, checksum, corruption, low-disk, partial-report tests
done_when: bundle integrity and redaction state are machine-verifiable

tasks.title: Freeze Ui Message Contract
write_scope: UI protocol schemas, Python/TypeScript generated types, contract tests
validation: cross-language schema fixtures
done_when: frontend and Python can evolve without implicit payload contracts

tasks.title: Build Dashboard Shell
validation: keyboard order, responsive snapshots, theme checks
done_when: shell works with fixture data and no live transport

tasks.title: Build Charts Tables Controls
validation: chart/table parity, keyboard operation, exact-value access, large-series performance
done_when: no chart is the sole access path to data

tasks.title: Implement Dashboard Accessibility
read: accessibility spec and manual test script
validation: axe, keyboard script, screen-reader spot checks, contrast, reduced-motion snapshots
done_when: WCAG 2.2 AA release checklist has no known blocker

tasks.title: Integrate Widget Transport
validation: Jupyter/Colab adapter tests, missing manager, rejected activation, transport loss, wheel asset tests
done_when: enhanced display is local, bounded, and optional

tasks.title: Build Static Fallback
validation: no-JavaScript rendering, screen-reader structure, unavailable-capability tests
done_when: monitoring remains usable without custom widgets

tasks.title: Run Dashboard Integration
write_scope: UI integration/e2e tests and validation evidence
validation: browser/widget e2e, payload/backpressure, focus, resize, long-run tests
done_when: enhanced and fallback paths share the same truthful data contract

tasks.title: Create Colab Snippets
validation: static safety scan and source/docs equality
done_when: snippets contain no hidden behavior and return concrete paths

tasks.title: Create Example Notebooks
validation: notebook structure/output hygiene and smoke execution where supported
done_when: examples are reproducible and do not duplicate drifting snippets

tasks.title: Scaffold Fumadocs Site
write_scope: `apps/docs/**` excluding generated API/snippet pages owned by later tasks
validation: locked install, typecheck, build, route smoke, theme/keyboard checks
done_when: docs shell is production-buildable and product-first

tasks.title: Write Product Docs
validation: link, snippet, API/schema, terminology, and content-coverage checks
done_when: all public capabilities and limitations are documented

tasks.title: Add Seo Ai Ready Docs
validation: structured-data parse, canonical/robots/sitemap, generated-index drift, XSS fixture tests
done_when: conventional SEO is primary and AI aids are accurate and bounded

tasks.title: Audit Docs Accessibility
validation: axe, keyboard, contrast, reduced motion, screen-reader spot checks
done_when: docs meet the same WCAG 2.2 AA target as the dashboard

tasks.title: Configure Pre Commit
validation: clean full run plus negative fixtures
done_when: hooks are deterministic, documented, and do not hide broad rewrites

tasks.title: Add Python Ci
validation: workflow lint and local command parity
done_when: supported versions and package contents are exercised

tasks.title: Add Ui Docs Ci
validation: workflow lint and local command parity
done_when: dashboard assets and docs cannot drift silently

tasks.title: Add Notebook Policy Ci
validation: safe negative fixtures and CPU-only smoke
done_when: distributed notebooks are inspectable and policy-safe

tasks.title: Plan Vercel Deployment
write_scope: Vercel/docs deployment config and workflow only after approval
validation: preview smoke, headers, canonical domain, rollback drill
done_when: preview and production boundaries are reviewable and reversible

tasks.title: Plan Package Release
validation: dry-run artifact build/inspection; no publication in planning
done_when: publication cannot be triggered from normal pull-request CI

tasks.title: Run Performance Soak
validation: documented methodology and raw evidence
done_when: release budgets are evidence-based and regressions are gated

tasks.title: Run Security Privacy Audit
write_scope: security fixes, threat model, validation evidence
validation: policy scan, secret scan, artifact audit, malicious fixture tests
done_when: no critical/high unresolved issue is hidden

tasks.title: Run Colab Smoke Matrix
write_scope: validation evidence and compatibility docs only unless repairs are needed
validation: install/start/display/collect/diagnose/stop/export evidence
done_when: supported and degraded runtime claims match observed behavior

tasks.title: Run Final Accessibility Audit
validation: WCAG 2.2 AA matrix and known-exception ledger
done_when: no blocking accessibility defect remains

tasks.title: Build Release Candidate
write_scope: generated release artifacts outside tracked source plus release docs
validation: clean-environment install, artifact manifest, docs build, policy scan
done_when: candidate is reproducible and inspectable

tasks.title: Finalize Verify Sync Readiness
validation: full quality suite and OpenSpec strict validation
done_when: readiness decision and residual risks have evidence
